feeds.title: ThereminGoat's Switches
feeds.description: It's me, Goat. I'm a fellow mechanical keyboard enthusiast and switch collector who joined the community a handful of years ago now with relatively benign intentions, to say the least. My hope is that I can share my collection and acquired knowledge about switches over the years of collecting through this website and all of the posts I plan to make in the future.

feeds.title: Keyshorts Blog
feeds.description: Blog about working and being creative from home, tricks & hacks to personalize stuff around you, and getting to know your tech better. We are Anna & Sebastian. We run Keyshorts, a brand of beautiful and useful keyboard stickers and skins. Check it out to see how we can change your life and work.

feeds.title: Dygma Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about the most advanced ergonomic split keyboard designed to improve the health and performance of gamers, coders, typists, and designers. Dygma has created the only ergonomic mechanical gaming keyboard designed to enhance performance, health, and comfort.

feeds.title: Mechanical Keyboard
feeds.description: Mechanical keyboards are getting more and more popular, for gaming as well as typing. The market is more complex now and it's not that easy anymore, to find the best mechanical keyboard for your needs. Here you will find a basic introduction to mechanical keyboards and their advantages, current news and an overview of the best mechanical keyboards. Mechanical-Keyboard was created with the goal, to offer the most comprehensive list of mechanical keyboards in the web.

feeds.title: Alexotos
feeds.description: A tech blog for enthusiasts and anyone looking to learn about the hobby. My goal is to document my computer setup process and share everything I learn. I'm Alex! I have a passion for building custom mechanical keyboards. to me, it's not just a keyboard. it's a tool we use to interact with others, that we use for our livelihood, and even what we use to express our creativity. it's an extension of us. the goal I had in mind was, and is, to create a welcoming and friendly community for any like-minded individuals.

feeds.title: Kinetic Labs Blog
feeds.description: The latest guides, tutorials, and resources to learn how to get started with custom mechanical keyboards. Learn to build guides and tutorials from community experts. Kinetic Labs helps you customize your keyboard to match the look and feel that will make you most productive.

feeds.title: Keychron Blog
feeds.description: Everything about Keychron keyboard, mouse, switch and behind-the-scenes stories. We've partnered a factory with 20 years of experience, which produces top-notch keyboards for many well-known keyboard brands over the years.

feeds.title: Matt3o

feeds.title: Keyboard Clack

I hope I can share with you my passion and information about keyboards & accessories in this blog.

feeds.description: My goal with this blog is to build a single resource where beginners can learn about mechanical keyboards and to show the web what this hobby is all about.

feeds.title: KeebNews
feeds.description: KeebNews is a site dedicated to the fabulous hobby of building, customizing, and typing on mechanical keyboards! My name is Pete McPherson, and I'm a huge keyboard nerd. I started this site to help beginners discover the hobby & learn the basics, give my own simplified methods for modding keyboards and offer my unbiased reviews on popular boards, switches, and accessories.
